name: DigiAsia Corp.
summary: Headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, DigiAsia Corp. operates an advanced artificial intelligence-powered embedded finance platform across Southeast Asia. The company provides a comprehensive B2B fintech ecosystem, delivering solutions for bill payments, supply chain finance, and agent-based banking to its merchants, partners, and customers. Its diverse product offerings include digital wallets, a QRIS Payment-as-a-Service, and a sophisticated Cash Management system that integrates with ERP platforms to enable closed-loop fund management. The "Digital Product & Billers" feature empowers users to acquire various digital goods or settle invoices with multiple service providers. Furthermore, a dedicated Remittance Product facilitates a wide array of money transfers, including cash-to-cash, cash-to-account, account-to-cash, and account-to-account transactions. DigiAsia Corp. also extends its services to include B2B loan products specifically designed for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), gold savings options, and Virtual Card Numbers for generating digital invoices to streamline online payment acceptance. The popular Buy Now Pay Later scheme is also available. For secure and regulatory-compliant client onboarding, an e-KYC module is provided. The company additionally establishes widespread Cash in & Cash Out points. Through KasPro Bank, it enables traditional banks and financial service institutions to utilize their existing retail networks as licensed digital banking agents, offering essential cash deposit and withdrawal services to MSMEs.
